boundaries: MAN-05 remains lead-owned and untouched; its correction is a lead/Codex coordination slice
every refusal stays a refusal: no refused snapshot was promoted, measured, or admitted
refused bytes remain preserved in quarantine with their manifest identities
no vehicle is re-identified across sessions; the raw refs quoted here are feed-published operator/vehicle codes inside refused snapshots, used only to name the defect

density_dependence.mechanism: a refusal requires two overlapping-numbered vehicles to report in the same snapshot second, so the hazard rises with fleet size — which is why it strikes rush hour and never struck the night probe

invariant_across_all_four: exactly one conflicting identity group per refused snapshot
exactly two vehicle activities in that group
the two activities always belong to DIFFERENT operators
grouping by (OperatorRef, VehicleRef, RecordedAtTime) leaves ZERO conflicts
finding.not_a_single_persistent_pair: four refusals name three distinct VehicleRef values, so this is a family of overlapping numbering ranges rather than one bad vehicle
finding.one_line_reproduction: group VehicleActivity by (OperatorRef, VehicleRef, RecordedAtTime) instead of (VehicleRef, RecordedAtTime)
finding.operator_asymmetry: BNGN appears in all four refusals, ANWE in three, HIPK in one; the overlap is not symmetric noise
finding.same_collision_recurs_within_a_window: the two evening refusals are the same VehicleRef 3042 (ANWE line 2 vs BNGN line 582) 22 minutes apart, so a collision persists while both vehicles stay in service — which is why simply retrying does not escape it
finding.summary: all four refusals are the same defect: a bare VehicleRef identity collides across operators

method.gzip: BODS wire bytes are gzip; the manifest hash covers the STORED bytes and is checked before decompression
method.integrity: each member re-read from its quarantine, hashed, and verified against the quarantine manifest before parsing; all four verified
method.kind: offline read-only replay over preserved quarantine bytes
method.note: this is a diagnosis of a lead-owned surface, not a change to it

operational_cost_measured.after_the_resilient_runner: the evening session absorbed its refusal at attempt 20 and continued; see the session record
operational_cost_measured.why_it_matters: an owner-attended rush-hour window is not reproducible on demand, and a single fail-closed refusal was discarding the whole window
windows_lost_before_the_resilient_runner: morning peak retry ended after 51 promotions

population: every fail-closed MAN-05 refusal recorded on 28 July 2026, across four attended windows
